vulnerability.explanation: A newly allocated xmlSchemaFacet (facet = xmlSchemaNewFacet()) has its value field set to the caller-provided pointer 'val' (facet->value = val). The function then frees the facet via xmlSchemaFreeFacet(facet) on both the error path (lines 2458–2461) and the success path (line 2463). xmlSchemaFreeFacet frees facet->value, leading to freeing memory that the function does not own. Since 'val' typically points to Relax NG parameter text managed elsewhere, this causes an invalid free and can later result in a double-free when the original owner frees the same memory.
